result.reviewScopeSummary: Initial verification for Story 5 covered AC-5.1 through AC-5.5, TC-5.1 through TC-5.5, the process-suite carry-over legs, materialize production code, CLI production code, render-target tests, process tests, and the PI-session fixture/provenance. Gates passed, but AC-5.5/TC-5.4 has a blocking CLI stdout contract mismatch.

newFindings.title: CLI pull/materialize stdout does not match the story contract
newFindings.evidence: Story AC-5.5 and TC-5.4 require `view pull` to emit the JSON message array and `view materialize` to print the written path (`stories/05-render-targets.md:35-36`; `test-plan.md:47`). Production code instead routes both commands through `renderResult` (`src/cli/view.ts:140-141`, `src/cli/view.ts:172-186`), and `renderResult` serializes the full OpResult wrapper (`src/cli/render.ts:14-18`). A direct probe after build showed `node dist/cli.js view pull --file-path ... --json` printing `{ "ok": true, "value": { "messages": [], "meta": ... } }`, not a top-level array. The process test reinforces the wrong contract by parsing OpResult via `parseResult`/`expectOk` and then unwrapping `.value` (`test/cli-process-view.test.ts:58-65`, `test/cli-process-view.test.ts:156-164`, `test/cli-process-view.test.ts:178-181`).

verified: AC-5.1 / TC-5.1: `view-render-targets.test.ts` verifies band messages in brief -> detailed -> smooth order, labels, tail record order, roles, and deterministic repeated pulls; covered by `pnpm run green-verify`.

AC-5.2 / TC-5.2: `view-render-targets.test.ts` verifies materialize writes a PI-session file, repeats byte-identically, derives header/band fields from metadata, and leaves full thread state hash unchanged; covered by `pnpm run green-verify`.

AC-5.3 / TC-5.2 / TC-5.5: `materialize.ts` renders from the shared assembled view entries, and `view-render-targets.test.ts` verifies item-for-item pull/file parity plus PI-session conformance and parentId chain; covered by `pnpm run green-verify`.
AC-5.4 / TC-5.3: `view-render-targets.test.ts` verifies never-compacted materialize produces a valid tail-only file with header timestamp/id from thread metadata; covered by `pnpm run green-verify`.
Format fixture DoD: `pi-session-structure.jsonl` exists with provenance in `pi-session-structure.provenance.md` identifying PI coding agent 0.79.1 and session format version 3.

Process carry-over legs: `cli-process-view.test.ts` covers spawned sweep receipt parity, compact receipt parity, profile violation nonzero, missing-thread structured errors, zero-provider CLI env, and CLI intake boundary advance; covered by `pnpm run verify-all`.
unverified: AC-5.5 / TC-5.4 exact stdout contract: production `view pull` emits an OpResult object instead of the JSON message array, and `view materialize` emits an OpResult object containing `writtenPath` instead of printing the path.

productionPathFindings: S5-001: production CLI render path for `view pull` and `view materialize` returns the OpResult wrapper rather than the story-required top-level message array/path.
additionalObservations: No fake adapter, mock runtime path, placeholder branch, or provider-backed workaround was found in the Story 5 production render-target paths. Test fakes are confined to fixture/provider setup.
